info.name: stackyrd — Local API
info.description:
# stackyrd — Postman Collection

Modular service framework on **Echo v4** (`github.com/diameter-tscd/stackyrd`).

- **Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` → default `http://localhost:8452` (see `config.yaml → server.port`)
- **Service prefix:** `{{apiBase}}` → `{{baseUrl}}/api/v1` (`server.services_endpoint`). All business services live here.
- **Infra routes** (MCP, metrics, swagger, health) are mounted at **root**, not under `/api/v1` — except the inbound webhook which is `{{apiBase}}/webhook`.
- **Response envelope** (`pkg/response/response.go`): every service returns
  ```json
  { "success": true, "status": 200, "message": "...", "data": {}, "meta": { "page": 1, "per_page": 10, "total": 2, "total_pages": 1 }, "timestamp": 1726140000, "datetime": "2026-09-12T00:00:00Z", "correlation_id": "req-..." }
  ```
  Errors: `{ "success": false, "status": 404, "error": { "code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "...", "details": {} } }`. Validation failures are **422 `VALIDATION_ERROR`** on Users, **400 `BAD_REQUEST`** elsewhere.
- **Correlation:** every request sends `X-Request-ID: {{requestId}}` + `X-Correlation-ID: {{correlationId}}` (auto-generated in the collection pre-request script). The server echoes one of them back as `correlation_id`.
- **Run order:** run the folder `00 · Health & Platform` first, then `Users` (captures `{{userId}}`), `Tasks` (captures `{{taskId}}`), `Mongo Products` (captures `{{productId}}`), `Orders` (captures `{{orderId}}`), `Cache` (captures `{{cacheKey}}`), `Encryption` (captures `{{encryptedData}}`). Later requests reuse those variables — this is the correlation chain.

## Authentication — read this first

| Layer | Config | What to send | Status in this repo |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.type: apikey` | `config.yaml → auth.secret: super-secret-key` | **Nothing enforced.** No `apikey` middleware is registered, so service routes are open. Kept for docs/Swagger `ApiKeyAuth` only. | Open |
| `jwt` middleware | `middleware.jwt: false` | When enabled: `Authorization: Bearer <HS256 JWT, iss=stackyrd, aud=stackyrd-api>` | **Disabled** — factory errors out unless `auth.type==jwt`. Requests in this collection carry no JWT. |
| **MCP token** | `mcp.token: {{mcpToken}}` | `Authorization: Bearer {{mcpToken}}` **or** `X-MCP-Token: {{mcpToken}}` **or** `X-Api-Key: {{mcpToken}}` **or** `?token={{mcpToken}}` | **Required** for `POST {{baseUrl}}/mcp` and `GET {{apiBase}}/events/stream/dashboard-logs`. The MCP folder uses Bearer auth; dashboard-logs has both an authed (200 SSE) and unauthed (401) case. |
| Webhook HMAC | `webhook.secret` | `X-Webhook-Signature: HMAC-SHA256(hex, body)` | Outbound signing demo is in the Webhook folder pre-request script. |
| `permission_check` | `middleware.permission_check: true` | — | **Blocks ALL `DELETE` by default** (`blocked_methods=[DELETE]`). DELETE Tasks/Products/Orders/Grafana-dashboard requests assert `200 OR 403` and explain how to unblock. |

## Known quirks encoded as tests

- `GET /api/v1/products` (static) and `GET /api/v1/products/:tenant` (Mongo) **share the `/products` group** — a `:tenant` value of e.g. `primary` routes to Mongo, anything else may collide.
- Mongo `/:tenant/search` and `/:tenant/analytics` are registered **after** `/:tenant/:id`, so Echo matches `/products/acme/search` as `:id=search` first (shadowed). Tests assert `200` and note this.
- `PUT /tasks/:id` uses map-update so `completed:false` is applied (zero-value safe). The update test flips `completed` true→false explicitly.
- `POST /orders/:tenant` **forces** `tenant_id=:tenant, status=pending` — body values for those fields are ignored.
- SSE streams (`/events/stream/:id`) return `text/event-stream`, not JSON — folder tests branch on content-type.
- Global caps: `BodyLimit 2M`, `ReadHeaderTimeout 5s`, `ReadTimeout 15s` (`internal/server/server.go`). One negative test posts an oversized body expecting `413`.

variable.description: Echo server. Override with -port flag value. server.port in config.yaml.
server.services_endpoint prefix. All business services mount here via registry.Boot().
mcp.token from config.yaml. Sent as Bearer for /mcp and dashboard-logs stream. Rotate in production; leave empty to auto-generate temp token.
Postgres connection name for Tasks default conn + Orders tenants (primary|secondary per config.yaml).
Auto-regenerated per request by the collection pre-request script. Sent as X-Request-ID.
Auto-regenerated per request. Sent as X-Correlation-ID; server echoes as correlation_id.
ISO timestamp set by pre-request script, used in broadcast bodies.
Captured by 'Users — Create'. Seed users are id 1 (Alice) and 2 (Bob).
Captured by 'Orders — Create'. Requires Postgres tenant.
Mongo ObjectID hex captured by 'Mongo Products — Create'.
SSE stream id. Demo streams: demo-notifications, demo-metrics, demo-alerts, dashboard-logs (auth).
base64(nonce|ciphertext) captured by 'Encryption — Encrypt'. Service disabled by default (services.encryption_service=false).
Captured by 'Grafana — Create Dashboard'. Service disabled by default.

exec: // Collection pre-request: fresh correlation IDs for every request.
// Server echoes X-Request-ID (preferred) or X-Correlation-ID as `correlation_id` (pkg/response/response.go:getCorrelationID).
// Default dynamic IDs so a cold run still works before captures fire.
// Collection test: runs after EVERY request (request-level tests add specifics).
pm.test('✉️ envelope has success flag', function () { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('success'); });
} catch (e) { pm.test('valid JSON body', function () { pm.expect(false, 'body was not JSON: ' + e).to.be.true; }); }

item.name: 00 · Health & Platform
item.description: Server liveness, dependency inventory, safe runtime config. Mounted directly on Echo in `internal/server/server.go:registerHealthEndpoints` — **not** under `/api/v1` (except `/api/v1/config`). No auth.

item.name: Health — Liveness + infra progress
item.description: `GET /health`. `status: ok|initializing`, `server_ready`, per-component `infrastructure` map, `initialization_progress` (async infra boot). Skipped by audit middleware.

item.name: Health — Dependencies inventory
item.description: `GET /health/dependencies`. Lists sealed infra components + registered service factories. Useful to confirm Postgres/Mongo/Redis came up before calling Tasks/Orders/Products.

item.name: Platform — Runtime config (safe subset)
item.description: `GET /api/v1/config`. Returns only safe blocks: app, server, services, middleware, mcp, metrics, log, audit. Never secrets.

item.name: Platform — Prometheus metrics (disabled by default)
item.description: `GET /metrics` (`metrics.path`). Only mounted when `metrics.enabled=true`. Default config has no metrics block → expect **404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND**. Enable to get Prometheus text exposition.

exec: pm.test('404 when disabled, 200 when enabled', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]); });

item.name: Platform — Swagger UI redirect (disabled by default)
item.description: `GET /swagger` → 301 `/swagger/index.html` + `GET /swagger/*` (swaggo). Only when `swagger.enabled=true` (default false; absent from config.yaml → off). Regenerate docs with `./scripts/yrd swagger`.

exec: pm.test('301 redirect or 404 when disabled', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 301, 302, 404]); });

item.name: 01 · Users (in-memory)
item.description: CRUD over an in-memory slice (seed: Alice id=1, Bob id=2). `internal/services/modules/users_service.go`. No DB, no auth. Validation via `request.Bind` + go-playground/validator: `name*`, `email*`, `phone` (custom regex), `username` (`^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,20}$`), `age 0..130`. Failures → **422 VALIDATION_ERROR**. Pagination is manual: `page>total` → **400**.

item.name: Users — 01 List (paginated)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/users?page=1&per_page=10`. `per_page` clamped 1..100. Response `data: User[]` + `meta`.

exec: pm.test('data is array + meta paginates', function () {

item.name: Users — 02 Create (captures userId)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/users`. Body validated; on success **201** with auto-increment id. Post-script saves `{{userId}}` for Get/Update correlation.

exec: // Postman dynamic vars: unique user per run to avoid collisions.
var body = { name: 'Charlie ' + n, email: 'charlie.' + n + '@example.com', phone: '+15551234567', username: 'ch_' + n, age: 28 };

item.name: Users — 03 Get by ID (correlated)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/users/:id` using `{{userId}}` captured above. 400 on non-int id, 404 when missing.

item.name: Users — 04 Update (full replace)
item.description: `PUT {{apiBase}}/users/:id`. Full-replace semantics — send the whole User object. 422 on bad email/username/age.

item.name: Users — 05 Create invalid (422 negative)
item.description: Negative test: bad email + bad username + age>130 → **422 VALIDATION_ERROR** with `error.details{field:msg}`. Proves trust-boundary validation.

exec: pm.test('code is VALIDATION_ERROR with field details', function () {

item.name: Users — 06 Get missing (404 negative)
item.description: `GET /users/999999` → **404 NOT_FOUND**. Also try `GET /users/abc` for the 400 invalid-id branch.

item.name: 02 · Tasks (Postgres)
item.description: GORM-backed tasks (`Task{gorm.Model,title,description,completed}`). Requires **Postgres** default connection + AutoMigrate. `PUT` binds into a fresh struct (URL id wins) and map-updates so `completed:false` is applied. ⚠️ `DELETE` is blocked by default (`permission_check.blocked_methods=[DELETE]` → 403) — the delete request asserts `200 OR 403` and tells you how to unblock.

item.name: Tasks — 01 List (paginated)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/tasks?page=1&per_page=10`. Ordered `id desc`. Needs Postgres; without it the service reports `failed` state.

item.name: Tasks — 02 Create (captures taskId)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/tasks` → **201** with GORM `Task{ID,CreatedAt,…}`. Captures `{{taskId}}`.

item.name: Tasks — 03 Update (zero-value safe)
item.description: `PUT {{apiBase}}/tasks/{{taskId}}`. Flips `completed` false→true using the map-update path; a second run flipping true→false proves zero-values apply.

item.name: Tasks — 04 Delete (403 when permission_check on)
item.description: `DELETE {{apiBase}}/tasks/{{taskId}}`. With default `permission_check` this returns **403 `Permission Denied: DELETE actions are restricted.`** To allow: scope `middleware.permission_check.blocked_paths` or disable the middleware.

exec: pm.test('200 deleted OR 403 blocked by permission_check', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 403]); });
if (pm.response.code === 403) { console.log('DELETE blocked by permission_check middleware (default blocked_methods=[DELETE])'); }

item.name: Tasks — 05 Update invalid id (400 negative)
item.description: `PUT /tasks/abc` → **400 Invalid task ID** (strconv.Atoi branch).

item.name: 03 · Products static + Mongo tenants
item.description: ⚠️ **Route collision by design:** `products_service` (static demo) and `mongodb_service` (tenant CRUD) both mount `g.Group("/products")`. `GET /products` (no tenant) hits the static list; anything with `:tenant` hits Mongo. Mongo needs a `mongo` connection named `{{mongoTenant}}` (default `primary`, see `config.yaml → mongo.connections`). `search`/`analytics` are registered AFTER `/:tenant/:id` so `/products/acme/search` matches as `:id=search` first (shadowed) — noted in tests.

item.name: Products — Static list (no DB)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/products` → static `[{Laptop 999.99},{Mouse 29.99},{Keyboard 79.99}]`. No params, no auth.

item.name: Mongo Products — 01 List by tenant
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/products/{{mongoTenant}}?page=1&per_page=10`. Sort `_id:-1`. **404** `Tenant database 'x' not found` when the connection name is wrong — try `?tenant=bad` variant by editing the path.

item.name: Mongo Products — 02 Create (captures productId)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/products/{{mongoTenant}}`. Server strips client `_id` and assigns ObjectID. Requires `name*`, `price>=0`, `quantity>=0`. Captures `{{productId}}` (hex).

exec: if (pid) { pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', String(pid)); console.log('captured productId=' + pid); }

item.name: Mongo Products — 03 Get by ID (correlated)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/products/{{mongoTenant}}/{{productId}}`. 400 on non-hex id, 404 when missing.

item.name: Mongo Products — 04 Update
item.description: `PUT {{apiBase}}/products/{{mongoTenant}}/{{productId}}` — `$set` of name/description/price/category/in_stock/quantity/tags.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Ergo Chair Pro",
  "description": "Mesh office chair, updated",
  "price": 279.0,
  "category": "furniture",
  "in_stock": true,
  "quantity": 10,
  "tags": ["office"]
}

item.name: Mongo Products — 05 Search (shadowed-route note)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/products/{{mongoTenant}}/search?q=chair`. Literal-regex over name|description|category (`QuoteMeta`, q max 100). NOTE: registered after `/:tenant/:id`, so Echo may match `:id=search` first — test accepts 200 or 400/404 and logs the outcome.

exec: console.log('If 400/404 with :id=search semantics, reorder routes so /search registers before /:id');

item.name: Mongo Products — 06 Analytics ($group by category)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/products/{{mongoTenant}}/analytics` → `[{_id,count,avgPrice,totalValue}]`. Same shadowing caveat as search.

item.name: Mongo Products — 07 Delete (403 when permission_check on)
item.description: `DELETE {{apiBase}}/products/{{mongoTenant}}/{{productId}}`. Blocked by default permission_check → 403. Unblock per Tasks note.

item.name: 04 · Orders (multi-tenant Postgres)
item.description: Tenant-isolated orders (`MultiTenantOrder{tenant_id,customer_id,product_name,quantity>0,total_price,status=pending}`). One Postgres connection per `:tenant` (`{{pgTenant}}` = primary|secondary). Create **forces** `tenant_id=:tenant, status=pending` (body values ignored); rejects `quantity<0||price<0`. Update is partial (only non-zero fields; empty → 400).

item.name: Orders — 01 List by tenant
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/orders/{{pgTenant}}`. 404 unknown tenant, 503 ORM nil.

exec: pm.test('200 or 404/503 without tenant DB', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404, 503]); });

item.name: Orders — 02 Create (captures orderId)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/orders/{{pgTenant}}`. `tenant_id`/`status` in body are ignored — server forces them. Captures `{{orderId}}` (gorm `ID`).

item.name: Orders — 03 Get by ID (correlated)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/orders/{{pgTenant}}/{{orderId}}` — scoped `WHERE(id AND tenant_id)` so cross-tenant reads 404.

item.name: Orders — 04 Partial update
item.description: `PUT {{apiBase}}/orders/{{pgTenant}}/{{orderId}}`. Only non-zero/non-empty fields update; send e.g. just `status`. Empty body → 400 `No fields to update`.

item.name: Orders — 05 Delete (403 when permission_check on)
item.description: `DELETE {{apiBase}}/orders/{{pgTenant}}/{{orderId}}`. `RowsAffected==0` → 404; default middleware → 403.

item.name: 05 · Cache (in-memory TTL)
item.description: In-memory `cache.Cache[string]` (`cache_service.go`). `POST /cache/:key {value, ttl_seconds 1..2592000}` → `ttl: "1h0m0s"`; `GET /cache/:key` → `{key,value}` or 404 on miss/expiry. No auth.

item.name: Cache — 01 Set (captures cacheKey)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/cache/{{cacheKey}}`. Pre-request refreshes `{{cacheKey}}` to `k-<ts>` so reruns don't collide. TTL 3600.

item.name: Cache — 02 Get (correlated)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/cache/{{cacheKey}}` — must run right after Set (same in-memory store, same process).

item.name: Cache — 03 Set invalid TTL (400 negative)
item.description: `ttl_seconds: 0` → **400** `ttl_seconds must be between 1 and 2592000`. Boundary also rejects >2592000 (30d).

item.name: Cache — 04 Get miss (404 negative)
item.description: `GET /cache/does-not-exist-<ts>` → **404** `Key not found or expired`.

item.name: 06 · Events broadcast (SSE)
item.description: Realtime via `utils.EventBroadcaster` (`broadcast_service.go`). `POST /events/broadcast {stream_id?,type*,message*,data?}` (empty stream_id → all streams). `GET /events/stream/:id` is **SSE** (`text/event-stream`, open-ended — set a client timeout). `dashboard-logs` requires MCP auth (401 raw `{error}` otherwise). Demo generators tick every 3s.

item.name: Events — 01 Active streams
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/events/streams` → `{streams:{id:{clients,active}},total_clients,stream_count}`.

item.name: Events — 02 Start stream
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/events/stream/{{streamId}}/start` → **201** created / **200** restarted. Starts the 3s demo generator.

item.name: Events — 03 Broadcast to stream
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/events/broadcast` with `stream_id={{streamId}}`. `type`+`message` required. Observe it on the SSE stream request.

item.name: Events — 04 Broadcast to ALL streams
item.description: Same endpoint with **empty/missing `stream_id`** → `BroadcastToAll`. Fans out to every active SSE client.

exec: pm.test('message mentions all streams', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('all streams'); });

item.name: Events — 05 Open SSE stream (text/event-stream)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/events/stream/{{streamId}}`. Returns infinite SSE (`data: {id,type,message,data,timestamp,stream_id}`). **Set Postman client timeout** (Settings → General → Request timeout) or close manually; the collection test only asserts headers + first bytes.

item.name: Events — 06 dashboard-logs WITHOUT token (401 negative)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/events/stream/dashboard-logs` with **no** token → **401** raw `{error: Unauthorized: valid MCP token required…}` (NOT the standard envelope — direct `c.JSON`).

item.name: Events — 07 dashboard-logs WITH token (SSE authed)
item.description: Same stream with `Authorization: Bearer {{mcpToken}}`. Alternatives the server accepts: `X-MCP-Token`, `X-Api-Key`, `?token=`. First frame is a log-shape `{timestamp,level,message,source}`.

item.name: Events — 08 Stop stream
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/events/stream/{{streamId}}/stop` → 200; unknown id → 404.

item.name: 07 · Encryption (disabled by default)
item.description: AES-256-GCM (`encryption_service.go`). Key = `sha256(config.encryption.key)` or random ephemeral. Disabled via `services.encryption_service=false` + `encryption.enabled=false` → expect **404** until enabled; tests accept `200 OR 404` so the suite stays green either way. Encrypt captures `{{encryptedData}}` for Decrypt correlation.

item.name: Encryption — Status
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/encryption/status` → `{enabled,algorithm,rotate_keys,last_rotation}`.

item.name: Encryption — Encrypt (captures encryptedData)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/encryption/encrypt {data*, content_type?}` → `{encrypted_data: base64(nonce|ct), algorithm: aes-256-gcm, timestamp}`. Captures `{{encryptedData}}`.

item.name: Encryption — Decrypt (correlated)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/encryption/decrypt {encrypted_data*}` using `{{encryptedData}}`. Must run after Encrypt with the **same process key** (ephemeral keys don't survive restarts).

item.name: Encryption — Rotate key
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/encryption/key-rotate {new_key* 32..128 chars}` → re-derives `sha256(new_key)`, invalidates AEAD cache. ⚠️ Rotating invalidates previously captured `{{encryptedData}}`.

item.name: 08 · Grafana (disabled by default)
item.description: Grafana proxy (`grafana_service.go`, needs `GrafanaManager`). Disabled via `services.grafana_service=false`. Dashboards CRUD + datasources + annotations + health. `:uid` must match `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`. Tests accept `200/201 OR 404` so the suite passes while disabled.

item.name: Grafana — Create dashboard (captures grafanaUid)
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/grafana/dashboards` → **201**. Minimal valid `GrafanaDashboard{title*, panels[]}`.

item.name: Grafana — Get dashboard
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/grafana/dashboards/{{grafanaUid}}`. 404 when missing.

item.name: Grafana — Update dashboard
item.description: `PUT {{apiBase}}/grafana/dashboards/{{grafanaUid}}`. `:uid` is overwritten into the body server-side.

item.name: Grafana — List dashboards
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/grafana/dashboards?page=1&per_page=50` (max 100), in-memory paginate.

item.name: Grafana — Create datasource
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/grafana/datasources {name*,type*,url,…}`.

item.name: Grafana — Create annotation
item.description: `POST {{apiBase}}/grafana/annotations {text*,dashboardId,panelId,time,tags}`.

item.name: Grafana — Health
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/grafana/health` → 200 or **503** when Grafana unreachable.

item.name: Grafana — Delete dashboard (403 when permission_check on)
item.description: `DELETE {{apiBase}}/grafana/dashboards/{{grafanaUid}}`.

item.name: 09 · Webhook (inbound HMAC)
item.description: Inbound `ANY {{apiBase}}/webhook` (`pkg/webhook/handler.go`, mounted `RouterCustom`). Expects `WebhookEvent{id,type,timestamp,data,signature}`, verifies `X-Webhook-Signature` HMAC-SHA256. **Inactive unless `webhook.enabled=true`** (no webhook block in default config → 404). Pre-request script signs the body with `{{webhookSecret}}`.

item.name: Webhook — POST signed event
item.description: Sends a signed event. Pre-request computes `X-Webhook-Signature` via CryptoJS HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body.

exec: } catch (e) { console.log('CryptoJS unavailable, sending unsigned: ' + e); }

item.name: Webhook — POST unsigned (negative)
item.description: Same event with **no** signature → expect 401/400 when enabled, 404 when disabled.

item.name: 10 · MCP server (JSON-RPC, Bearer)
item.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP at `POST {{baseUrl}}/mcp` (`pkg/infrastructure/mcpserver.go`, `mcp.enabled=true`). JSON-RPC 2.0 `{jsonrpc:2.0,id,method,params}`. Protocol versions `2026-07-28/2025-11-25/2025-03-26`. **Auth: `Authorization: Bearer {{mcpToken}}`** (folder-level) — server also accepts `X-MCP-Token`, `X-Api-Key`, `?token=`. `OPTIONS /mcp` for CORS; `GET /mcp` → 405. Tools: `stackyrd_health/services/infra/endpoints/uptime/resources/middleware/dashboard/app/identity/cluster/memory/goroutines/config/cron/cron_trigger/build/exec/filemanager/system_control/service_call/db`. `exec`/`filemanager`/`db` are gated by their `mcp.*_enabled` flags.

item.name: MCP — initialize (handshake)
item.description: `initialize {protocolVersion, capabilities, clientInfo}` → server capabilities + version. Send once per session; follow with `notifications/initialized`.

item.name: MCP — tools/list
item.description: Lists all 24 `stackyrd_*` tools with input schemas. Use to discover `stackyrd_exec` / `stackyrd_filemanager` / `stackyrd_db` availability.

exec: pm.test('200 with tools array', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: MCP — tools/call stackyrd_health
item.description: Calls the health tool — same data as `GET /health` but over MCP. Pattern for all `tools/call`: `{name, arguments}`.

item.name: MCP — tools/call stackyrd_services
item.description: Service states: running|failed|disabled (`registry.GetServiceState`). Failing = enabled but factory nil (missing infra).

item.name: MCP — tools/call stackyrd_infra
item.description: Infra component statuses. `GetStatus()` contract: `"connected": true` when operational (TUI shows disconnected otherwise).

item.name: MCP — tools/call stackyrd_endpoints
item.description: All registered service endpoints (mirrors TUI `endpoints` command).

item.name: MCP — ping
item.description: `ping {}` → liveness without auth weight. Good first check when debugging 401s.

item.name: MCP — no token (401 negative)
item.description: Same `tools/list` with **explicitly no auth** (`noauth` override) → **401** when `mcp.token` is set. Proves Bearer enforcement. If `mcp.token` is empty (auto-temp-token mode) this may 200 — test accepts both and logs.

exec: pm.test('401 without token (or 200 if token empty)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 401]); });

item.name: MCP — X-MCP-Token header alt auth
item.description: Proves the header alias: `X-MCP-Token: {{mcpToken}}` with `noauth` Bearer. Also valid: `X-Api-Key`, `?token=`.

item.name: 11 · Negative & Edge
item.description: Trust-boundary checks: unknown route (404 envelope with path+method details), wrong method (405), oversized body (413 via `BodyLimit 2M`). All hit `internal/server/server.go` handlers, not services.

item.name: Edge — Unknown route (404 envelope)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/nope` → **404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND** `Endpoint not found. This incident will be reported.` with `error.details{path,method}`.

item.name: Edge — Wrong method (405)
item.description: `PATCH {{apiBase}}/users` (no PATCH route) → **405 HTTP_ERROR** `Method not allowed`.

exec: pm.test('405 Method not allowed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(405); });

item.name: Edge — Pagination overflow (400)
item.description: `GET {{apiBase}}/users?page=9999` → **400** `Invalid pagination parameters` (manual `page>total` guard in users_service).
